systems.platform: police software developed by INTERPOL's WAPIS team
systems.owner: Centre national de documentation criminelle (CNDC), Ministry of Security and Civil Protection
systems.tiers: national centre; police, gendarmerie, customs, water and forests services as data sources

note: CNDC inaugurated about 18 September 2015 as national police data centre, funded by the EU; the article does not say stations enter reports or cases in the system.
